exercises.name: Close Grip Push Ups
exercises.cue: Slow and controlled for time under tension, core tight. Both hands stacked on the kettlebell handle, chest to the bell.
exercises.notes: Slow and controlled for time under tension, core tight. Both hands stacked on the kettlebell handle, chest to the bell.

evidence.quote: take these slow and controlled so that we get time under tension

as_performed.hand_placement: both hands stacked on the kettlebell handle, thumbs touching
as_performed.surface: hands elevated on the bell, feet on the mat

exercises.name: Deadlift With A High Pull
exercises.cue: Take your time so the legs do not add momentum; the upper body should do the pulling. One bell between the feet, elbows finish high.
exercises.notes: Take your time so the legs do not add momentum; the upper body should do the pulling. One bell between the feet, elbows finish high.

evidence.quote: Take your time with these reps so you don't get too much momentum from the legs

as_performed.hand_placement: both hands on the handle, bell between the feet
as_performed.load_position: between the feet, hangs at arm's length
as_performed.range_of_motion: floor to upper chest, elbows finish above the hands

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
exercises.cue: Hip hinge, tension through the glutes and hamstrings. Two hands, bell to chest height.
exercises.notes: Hip hinge, tension through the glutes and hamstrings. Two hands, bell to chest height.

evidence.quote: focusing on the hip hinge, finding that tension through the glutes and the hamstrings

as_performed.load_position: hangs between the legs, swings to chest height
as_performed.range_of_motion: Russian swing, bell to chest height, not overhead

exercises.name: Goblet Squats
exercises.cue: Below 90 degrees, then drive the ground away from you. Bell held by the horns at the chest.
exercises.notes: Below 90 degrees, then drive the ground away from you. Bell held by the horns at the chest.

evidence.quote: dropping down below 90 degrees and driving the ground away from you

as_performed.hand_placement: bell held by the horns at the chest

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.cue: Dip a few inches and drive the bell overhead with both hands from the goblet position.
exercises.notes: Dip a few inches and drive the bell overhead with both hands from the goblet position.

evidence.quote: the bell is pressed with both hands from the goblet position

as_performed.hand_placement: both hands on the horns, bell upside down
as_performed.load_position: starts at the chest in the goblet position, finishes overhead with arms locked

exercises.name: Plank Hold
exercises.cue: Squeeze the glutes and do not let the hips sag. Elbows under the shoulders.
exercises.notes: Squeeze the glutes and do not let the hips sag. Elbows under the shoulders.
